# Test fixtures

All files here are **synthetic**. They are hand-written to match the format of
OpenSky Network's `/states/all` response; they are not recorded OpenSky data and
the aircraft, addresses and callsigns are made up.

- `states_turkey_sample.json`: 8 valid rows (Istanbul, Ankara, Antalya on the
  ground, Athens, mid Black Sea, a US military block address with an `RCH`
  callsign, a row without position, Van) plus 2 malformed rows.
- `replay_synthetic.jsonl`: 80 snapshots (90 minutes) in the format written by
  `sema_collector --record`, generated by `tools/make_replay_fixture.py` with
  known injected events (signal losses, a teleport, bad altitude/speed/vertical
  rate, a duplicated address). Callsigns `SMX…`/`SMY…` and addresses are made up.
- `anomaly_synthetic.jsonl`: 80 snapshots (90 minutes), same format, generated
  by `tools/make_anomaly_fixture.py`: one scripted aircraft per anomaly rule
  (`SMA…`: a 7700 squawk, a single corrupt 7500 reply that must be ignored, a
  rapid descent, a turn-back at cruise, a holding, a 9 minute signal loss) and
  30 ordinary flights (`SMB…`) that must raise nothing.
